properties.name: presentation
properties.comment: How the choices are drawn: a row of buttons (the default) or a segmented control with a selection indicator behind the selected segment. Selection, keyboard and semantics are the same in both.

table.description: How the choices are drawn: buttons or a segmented control.

hand: the written hook switches each item between button and segment painting and arranges again

properties.name: selected_index
properties.comment: The selected item's index, or -1 for none (G14: an ordinary cell). Outside the items throws std::out_of_range; a bound Value may refuse it. A change checks the selected item's button and raises changed.
hand: prepare: the range check and the binding's refusal; written: apply_selection, then changed

not_properties.name: items
not_properties.reason: a collection replaced whole by set_items; stays a method until M-S
